experiment.bridgeAdmission: A synthetic↔physical bridge is admitted only if exact physical carrier identity/config is retained, the physical waveform is measurement-valid for this tolerance decision, one preregistered model is selected without post-data retuning, and post-reveal object identity agrees. A mismatch is a valid negative result, not a failed apparatus to be rewritten.
